note: The feeds the Hugo site served, read from the XML files of its build (public/**/index.xml): 59 feeds in five shapes. The old site served a feed of the articles of the site, a feed of the articles of every tag and of every category and a feed of the terms of every taxonomy. The Astro site serves a feed at every one of these routes. The routes that name a term are written with <term>, because the terms of the site are the terms of its articles: the feed of a term is served for every term the articles name.
